subtopic: Financial Planning and Asset Allocation Services
source_evidence: Advisers also may give advice about market trends or asset allocation or offer financial planning services.
answer: An investment adviser may offer financial planning services or advice about asset allocation—how investments are distributed among different types of assets. Advisers may also provide ongoing advice about buying, selling, or holding investments and monitor how those investments align with your overall objectives. The specific services depend on the agreement you make with the adviser.
